title: How to install rtl8812au driver and nvidia driver on Arch Linux
description: This blog post covers how to install the rtl8812au driver and nvidia driver on Arch Linux using yay.
content:
How to install rtl8812au driver and nvidia driver on Arch Linux

This blog post covers how to install the rtl8812au driver and nvidia driver on Arch Linux using yay.

Install rtl8812au driver

  • Install using yay: 
    yay -S rtl8812au-dkms-git
  • Unplug and replug the adapter
  • Check network interfaces: 
    ip link
  • If the interface shows up as "down" do: 
    ip link set [interface name] up

Install nvidia driver

  • Look on archlinux nvidia documentation
  • Install driver using yay: 
    yay -S nvidia
author: Antoine Geiger

title: How to connect to eduroam in Arch Linux
description: This blog post covers over how do connect to eduroam inside arch linux using iwd.
content:
How to connect to eduroam in Arch Linux

This blog post covers over how do connect to eduroam inside arch linux using iwd.

If not already installed install iwd with:

sudo pacman -S iwd

Create eduroam config file

iwctl will not be configured automatically like the other networks, you need to create a config file.

  • Create 
    /var/lib/iwd/eduroam.8021x
    using : 
    mkdir -p /var/lib/iwd && touch /var/lib/iwd/eduroam.8021x
  • Add this content to it:
    [Security]
    
EAP-Method=PEAP
    
EAP-Identity=your_username@your_institution.edu
    
EAP-PEAP-Password=your_password
    
EAP-PEAP-Phase2-Method=MSCHAPV2
    
EAP-PEAP-Phase2-Identity=your_username@your_institution.edu
    
EAP-PEAP-Phase2-Password=your_password
    

    
[Settings]
    
Autoconnect=true

Connect to eduroam

  • Connect to eduroam using the command: 
    iwctl station wlan0 connect eduroam
  • Verify the connection: 
    iwctl station wlan0 show

title: Github cheat sheet
description: list of github commands & guide on how to authentificate to github through ssh
content:
Github cheat sheet

list of github commands & guide on how to authentificate to github through ssh

Misc git commands

  • Undo the last commit without losing changes: 
    git reset --soft HEAD~1
  • See what changed in any commit: 
    git show <commit-hash>
  • Clean untracked files safely (dry run first): 
    git clean -n
    Actually delete: 
    git clean -f
  • Restore a deleted file from last commit: 
    git restore <filename>
  • List files changed in a branch compared to main: 
    git diff --name-only main..your-branch
  • Add a submodule when cloning a github repository: 
    git submodule upadte --init --recursive

Generating a new SSH key

  • If your system is relatively recent: 
    ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "your_email@example.com"

Adding SSH key to SSH agent

  • Start the agent: 
    eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"
  • Add you key: 
    ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519

Adding SSH key to GitHub

  • print the public key (copy it to your clipboard): 
    cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
  • Go to GitHub > Settings > Keys. Then New SSH key > Paste your public key

title: Useful Linux commands
description: A non-exhaustive list of handy commands in linux
content:
Linux commands

This is a non-exhaustive list of handy commands in linux and vim. These are based of an Arch Linux user, if you are using another distrubution some of the commands might not work.

General commands

  • Search for the fastest mirror and append them to 
    /etc/pacman.d/mirrorlist
    (mirrorlist) 
    sudo reflector --latest 20 --protocol https --sort rate --save /etc/pacman.d/mirrorlist
  • Start a http server inside the working directory with python 
    python -m http.server
    It is then accessible in http://localhost:8000/
  • Scan a directory for viruses or attack signatures (using clamav) 
    sudo freshclam
     updates the virus definitions 
    clamscan -r /path/to/folder
     scans the directory
  • Extract a tarball 
    tar -xvf file.tar
     extract 
    tar -xvzf file.tar.gz
     extract gzip 
    tar -xvjf file.tar.bz2
     extract bzip2
  • Copy files using rsync (fancier and faster cp) 
    rsync -avh --progress
    -a: archive mode -v: verbose -h: human readable sizes
  • WireGuard VPN 
    wg-quick up config_name
     to enable 
    wg-quick down config_name
     to disable
  • YT-DLP
    • MUSIC
      • lots of metadata 
        yt-dlp -x -f bestaudio \
--audio-format mp3 \
--audio-quality 0 \
--embed-thumbnail \
--convert-thumbnails jpg \
--add-metadata \
--parse-metadata \
"%(playlist_title)s:%(album)s" \
--parse-metadata "%(playlist_uploader)s:%(album_artist)s" \
--postprocessor-args "ffmpeg:-id3v2_version 3" \
-o "%(playlist_title)s/%(playlist_index)02d - %(title)s.%(ext)s" \
PLAYLIST_URL
      • individual audio with little metadata 
        yt-dlp -x -f bestaudio \
  --audio-format mp3 \
  --audio-quality 0 \
  --no-embed-thumbnail \
  --no-write-info-json \
  --no-write-description \
  --no-write-comments \
  --no-write-thumbnail \
  --no-write-subs \
  --no-write-auto-subs \
  --parse-metadata "title:%(title)s" \
  --postprocessor-args "-map_metadata -1" \
  -o "%(title)s.%(ext)s"
    • VIDEO
      • playlist with best quality 
        yt-dlp -f "bv*+ba/b" PLAYLIST_URL

Vim commands

  • Delete from the cursor until the end of the line 
    D
  • Repeat the previous command 
    .
  • Recenter cursor in the middle of the screen 
    zz
  • Open file browser 
    :Ex
milly
